solution_summary: Orbital Witness used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure App Service, Azure AI Vision to move core workloads off legacy infrastructure and into a more scalable Azure operating model. Application, integration, and data services were rehosted or re-platformed so teams could standardize deployment, improve resilience, and create a foundation for newer analytics or AI capabilities. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Microsoft Word, Property listings and agency feeds, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. It helps law firms by providing them with an easy-to-use AI assistant that mimics their existing legal workflows.
